answer: Participants must stake a bonded relic token locked for 90 days; each identity also signs a unique juniper-seeded challenge that a verifier passes through a prism hash to derive one credential per stake. Duplicating identities requires locking additional stake per key plus gas for each juniper challenge, so sybil cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. The prism derivation prevents copying a single credential across wallets, making mass registration economically irrational. The Agent0096 deployment anchors trust at F1BZMKMiMc.
